name: Bunless Beef Burgers with Sautéed Sweet Potatoes

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg sweet potatoes
3 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, Worcestershire, Dijon, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; mix well.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 tsp Worcestershire sauce
3 tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Form the beef mixture into 12 patties.
Once the pan / skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the beef patties to the pan / skillet; cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the potatoes.
Once the sauté pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with tomato slices, burger patties, and some mayo. Add the sweet potatoes on the side. Enjoy!
